instruction: Make the subtitle text on this slide italic.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires making the subtitle italic. Evaluator checks if shape 1 on slide 0 has italic formatting applied.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly identifies and checks the subtitle shape (shape_idx=1 on slide_idx=0)
Metric function properly uses python-pptx to read PPTX file and check italic formatting via run.font.italic
Parameter handling is correct - expected is accessed directly as rules dict (not expected.get('rules'))
Postconfig appropriately saves the file before evaluation to ensure changes are persisted
Logic correctly iterates through all paragraphs and runs to verify italic formatting
Minor edge case: If subtitle has no text or empty paragraphs/runs, function returns 1.0 (pass) without verifying any text was actually made italic - could lead to false positive in pathological cases
However, this edge case is unlikely in normal LibreOffice Impress usage where subtitles typically contain text
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider adding a check to ensure at least one run exists before returning 1.0, to avoid false positives for empty subtitles
Could add validation that the shape actually contains text before checking formatting
